blurb: Armadillo Boulders offers indoor bouldering with over 5,200 square feet of varied terrain and climbing-specific training zones. The facility includes a yoga studio and a functional fitness room with cardio, weights, and bodyweight training equipment. They provide programs for all ages and abilities, including youth teams and fitness classes.
